prenatal.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source image for an artistic 3D keepsake mesh, not a medical reconstruction.
Primary request: Create a refined warm ivory clay sculpture bust of a sleeping prenatal baby, inspired very loosely by the silhouette in the supplied ultrasound side-profile reference. The reference is only 2D ultrasound and cannot specify a true likeness or hidden geometry.
Input images: Image 1 is a visual inspiration reference for the rounded forehead and small nose/chin silhouette, not an identity or anatomical ground truth.
Subject: one complete intact fetal-inspired baby head, closed eyes, delicate small nose, quiet closed mouth, soft round cheeks, no hair, short neck and a little upper shoulders ending in a neat solid bust base. No full body. No ears missing. Head upright, turned only 15 degrees so both sides of face can be understood.
Style/medium: beautiful realistic sculpted clay miniature, smooth coherent continuous surface, subtle fine sculptural detail, no colorized skin, no medical scan textures.
Composition/framing: single isolated bust centered, full head and entire shoulder base visible, three-quarter nearly frontal view, head at top, base at bottom, ample transparent margin. No pedestal separate from bust. No framing circle.
Lighting: broad even soft studio lighting with very soft ambient occlusion to reveal actual form, no harsh shadows.
Materials: single uniform warm ivory matte clay with no pigmentation; closed eyelids same clay material.
Constraints: artistic interpretation only. Do not copy the ultrasound display, labels, black backdrop, grain, measurement markings, or imaging artifacts. Do not claim anatomical or identity accuracy. No text, no watermark, no other objects. Transparent background.
